signal: EliseAI raised $250M at a $2.2B valuation and is tripling its workforce while expanding across housing and healthcare.

email.body1:
Andre, saw EliseAI raised $250M at a $2.2B valuation and is tripling the team across housing and healthcare.

Growth that fast floods the SDR team with more accounts and inbound than reps can follow up on while ramping, and speed-to-lead slips. Our AI SDR handles research, writing, and follow-up autonomously, so reps stay in conversations: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I had our AI SDR draft three personalized emails to three of EliseAI's top target accounts. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through them?
email.subject2: your outbound, 3 things I would change
email.body2:
Andre, quick follow-up for EliseAI.

When the account list jumps post-raise across two verticals, the bottleneck is rarely the messaging, it is follow-up volume and response speed across reps who are still ramping. That is exactly where reply rate quietly leaks.

Worth 15 minutes? I will walk you through a teardown of EliseAI's current outbound, three things I would change. Our best-practice patterns alone usually lift response rates 50 to 70 percent.
email.body3:
Andre, last bit of proof for EliseAI.

Memgraph had more accounts in play than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how EliseAI's reply rate likely compares to other late-stage startups. Want to grab time so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Andre, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

If cutting follow-up load and ramp time is not a priority for the team this quarter, no problem at all. Tripling an org across two verticals is plenty to juggle.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your SDR motion? I will tailor it to EliseAI either way.
